prompt:
I playtested it. Problems:
- Zombies don't hurt me when they touch me.
- I never see the upgrade shop with offers between waves.
Please fix these before adding anything new.
result_text:
I made two edits to `src/server/Zombies.server.lua`, but I haven't run either one. There's no Rojo or Studio here, so please playtest them. I couldn't find one definite cause, so these are my best guesses.

- **Zombies set up as a humanoid rig without a neck:** The zombie rig has a Head and HumanoidRootPart but no Torso or Neck. I set `RequiresNeck = false` on the zombie humanoid. Roblox may otherwise treat the rig as broken, so the zombies wouldn't move or reach you. That one cause would explain both problems.
- **Contact damage blocked by ForceFields:** The contact damage used `hum:TakeDamage`, which a ForceField blocks. I switched it to subtract from `hum.Health` directly. That only matters if you have a ForceField on you, for example from spawn protection.

I read `Shop.lua`, `ShopUi.client.lua` and `Remotes.lua` and found no bug in them. The shop opens only after every zombie in a wave is dead. If the zombies never reach your blades, the wave never ends and the shop never appears.

If either problem is still there after this, tell me whether the zombies walk toward you at all, and whether they die. That will show which of the two is happening.
